annotations.title: Build a sheet from a shared template

description: Builds a new sheet in the person's Google Drive from a template sheet people share (from find_templates), once the person has seen its columns and said yes, and makes it one of their tracks: its tabs, formulas, Glance cards, questions and example rows come along, and its form. Charts, colours and other formatting don't: for those the person copies it in Google Sheets (copyUrl) and connects the copy. A template with a formula that reaches outside the sheet is refused.

name.description: The track's name. Leave out for the template's.
